title: Infinite ResNets are Gaussian Mean ODEs
abstract: arXiv:2610.41514v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Understanding the training dynamics of deep neural networks in large-scale limits is a question both of foundational and of practical importance. Prior works have obtained such descriptions through dynamical mean field theory (DMFT), yielding a system of non-Markovian dynamics that are challenging to analyze and that obscure the optimization structure of the original dynamics. In this paper, we obtain instead a simple description of the large-scale limit training dynamics for ResNets in standard shape scalings and in the $1/\text{depth}$ branch scaling that allows maximal (local) feature updates. For a model trained with gradient descent (GD) from a random initialization, the limit dynamics is simply GD on a Neural Mean ODE with Gaussian initial weights. translated_abstract: 理解深度神经网络在大规模极限下的训练动力学，既是一个基础性问题，也具有重要的实际意义。以往的工作通过动力学平均场理论（DMFT）获得了这类描述，但所得到的是一组难以分析的非马尔可夫动力学，并且掩盖了原始动力学的优化结构。在本文中，我们为ResNet在大规模极限下的训练动力学给出了一个更简单的描述，涵盖标准的形状缩放以及允许最大（局部）特征更新的 $1/\text{深度}$ 分支缩放。对于从随机初始化出发用梯度下降（GD）训练的模型，其极限动力学就是在具有高斯初始权重的神经均值ODE（Neural Mean ODE）上进行梯度下降。我们的分析覆盖了在大宽度、大深度以及嵌入、输入、输出维度的联合极限下，基于总体风险或经验风险的梯度下降。我们获得了依赖于……的近似缩放律（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 该论文证明，在大宽度与大深度的联合极限下，从随机初始化出发用梯度下降训练的ResNet，其训练动力学可简洁地等价于对具有高斯初始权重的神经均值ODE进行梯度下降，从而避免了以往DMFT描述中的非马尔可夫复杂性。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that in the joint large width and depth limit, gradient descent training of ResNets from random initialization is simply gradient descent on a Neural Mean ODE with Gaussian initial weights, avoiding the non-Markovian complexity of prior DMFT descriptions.
